tagline: Up off the cold floor and the wet grass, on a mesh deck you can hose clean.
lead: Your dog gets a dry, raised place to lie after a wet walk, instead of the cold hallway tiles.
value: There's no foam, filling or cover to soak up water, hold smell or flatten. Just a metal frame and mesh you hose down.
intro: Brook is a raised dog bed with a taut, breathable mesh deck on a metal frame, in Large, XL and XXL. No foam, no stuffing and no cover to wrestle off.
points: Air moves underneath, so heat isn't trapped between your dog and the tiles.
Breathable mesh spreads their weight instead of collapsing under it.
No foam and no loose filling to go soggy or get pulled out.
Rinse the frame and mesh and let it dry. No wash cycle, no damp bed smell.
Conservatory, utility room, garden, kennel or campsite.
best_for: Heavy-coated breeds, muddy dogs, hot sleepers and homes with hard floors.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. The whole deck is usable, with no bolster to lose space to. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Rinse the mesh and frame with water and let it dry fully. Keep it on a level surface and check the frame joints occasionally.
seo_title: Hose-Down Raised Mesh Dog Bed, Indoors or Out | Snoozly
seo_description: Keep your dog off cold, wet floors on a raised mesh bed you can hose down. Metal frame, no foam, no cover. Large, XL and XXL, for indoors or out.
